::: {.section-intro}

<span class="section-code">01 / RESEARCH QUESTION</span>

## Where is the pharmaceutical workforce heading?

Our analysis connects employer demand with the skills and career opportunities shaping pharmaceutical manufacturing. Rather than examining job counts alone, we evaluate what companies need, where opportunities are concentrated, and how candidates can prepare.

:::

::: {.feature-grid}

::: {.feature feature-primary}

<span class="feature-number">01</span>

### Establish the market baseline

Measure employment activity, employer concentration, occupational demand, and geographic patterns across the pharmaceutical manufacturing sector.

[Open market analysis →](market_baseline.qmd)

:::

::: {.feature}

<span class="feature-number">02</span>

### Identify emerging skill gaps

Compare the technical, analytical, regulatory, and operational capabilities requested across pharmaceutical job postings.

[Explore skill demand →](skill_gap_analysis.qmd)

:::

::: {.feature}

<span class="feature-number">03</span>

### Evaluate career pathways

Translate market evidence into practical career options and evaluate how roles differ in demand, accessibility, and future potential.

[Review career pathways →](career_evaluation.qmd)

:::
